name: Eazy
author: Hakita (GameBanana)
attribution: Converted from Deathrun_Eazy.bsp by Hakita (https://gamebanana.com/mods/126944, CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 as listed there). Geometry only: boxes and traps rebuilt from the map's brushes and entities, none of the author's textures, models or sounds. Shipped on the strength of credit and removal on request: tell the repository owner and the map is taken out.
blurb: A hall of rooms over a pit: a bridge that drops out under the runners, a ceiling-high push over two platforms and a hammer, a crusher, a slide of orange boxes, an explosion and a floor that rolls over, all of Eazy.
